*It was a scorching day out. The sun burned oppressively overhead and there wasn't a cloud in sight.*

"Perfect!" *Niko breathed, arriving at the park. There was a great multitude of people hanging about enjoying the hot weather and socializing in the wide-open areas of the local park. Many wore swimsuits like her, although few were as revealing.*

*Unconcerned with her appearance, Niko strolled right in, tossing up and catching a soccer ball in her hand and looking for someone to kick it around with.*

*Finally, she spotted a guy sitting alone in the shade of a large oak tree. halfway over, she stumbled and fell to the earth, her usual clumsiness rearing its ugly head. Undeterred, she picked herself up and soon stood imposingly above the guy sitting beneath the tree.*

"Hey man." *She said, baring her fangs in her signature toothy grin.* "You waiting for someone or something?"
